fonts.display: 'Libre Baskerville', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
fonts.body: 'Inter', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

palette.name: Carbon Canvas
palette.role: Primary page background; the foundational dark surface that all sections sit on

palette.name: Obsidian
palette.role: Deepest layer — footer, contrast blocks, shadow wells

palette.name: Graphite Card
palette.role: Card and input surfaces lifted one step above canvas

palette.name: Slate Elevated
palette.role: Elevated surfaces — table rows, hover states, secondary panels

palette.name: Iron Peak
palette.role: Highest surface tier — dropdowns, popovers, selected list items

palette.name: Bone
palette.role: Primary text and hairline borders — the dominant foreground tone

palette.name: Fog
palette.role: Muted helper text, icon strokes, disabled labels

palette.name: Smoke
palette.role: Subtle dividers, badge backgrounds, low-emphasis text

palette.name: Pure White
palette.role: Icon glyphs, card backgrounds for light-section contrast blocks, max-emphasis text

palette.name: Voltage Blue
palette.role: Sole chromatic accent — inline link highlights, selection, active state within data-dense terminal views; appears as the only color in an otherwise achromatic system

palette.name: Mid Navy
palette.role: Decorative deep-blue tone used in heading borders and subtle heading tints — adds depth without breaking the monochromatic discipline
